title: Approved ecosystem component & feature catalogue
scope: Officially indexed React components, patterns, feature/API topics, example recipes, development features, publicly named paid extensions, and every canonical Lucide icon in the retained official repository tree. Community registry contents, every prop/value combination, non-React framework APIs, unlisted paid variants and historical/deprecated aliases are not a finite component catalogue and are not individually enumerated.
assessment: Inventory only. No suitability, page placement or adoption recommendations have been made.
coverageNotes: The five ecosystems have different distribution models: registry source components, npm APIs, icons and separately licensed extensions are labelled individually.
Current documentation is a dated snapshot, not a promise that every entry exists in the pinned packages. New APIs and icon files may require a version change. No additional packages were installed.

shadcn/ui navigation is merged with its llms.txt index because their listings differ. AI interface patterns are first-party compositions; unrelated community registries are not treated as approved packages.

React Bits Pro block and app-UI variants are represented by every publicly indexed family and its stated variant count. The index advertises 20 Agent Kit items but names 19; no missing item is invented.
Lucide official repository tree contains 2014 canonical SVG names in this snapshot. Website search counts may lag. Aliases are an API feature, not separately counted icons.

Per-component dependency inspection is deferred to adoption review. A bulk React Bits registry metadata retrieval failed; the complete named component inventory still comes from its successfully retrieved official index. React Bits documents that dependencies vary and may include GSAP, Three.js or OGL. Listed does not mean approved for installation.

Used means directly used in this showcase or a documented capability exercised by it. It is a factual implementation label, not a recommendation. New developer-tool catalogue controls are not counted as site features.
